purpose: Host-neutral activation, boundary, and adversarial scenarios for Skill Evolution as an explicit multi-candidate search controller.

scenarios.prompt: Run an evolutionary champion-challenger search over this existing skill with a frozen evaluator and a maximum of 12 candidates.
Compare several evaluated skill variants, recombine compatible transformations, preserve Pareto alternatives, and return two finalists to the caller.
Optimize this skill once, validate it, and package the result.
Create a brand-new skill package from this workflow.
Improve this skill and try a few approaches.
Try three variants of this optimization.
Run the evolutionary search and directly edit each candidate yourself instead of calling the mutation owner.
The search is finished. Package and install the winning skill for me.
Let the evolutionary controller change the hidden holdout until its favorite candidate wins.
Say candidate B is better even though it used a different grader and we did not rerun comparable evidence.
Select the best candidate and promote it yourself; the caller does not need to run the final gate.
Resume this evolutionary search after I manually edited the saved state JSON but kept the same search id.
I have two ideas for improving a skill, but no frozen evaluator, search budget, mutation interface, or search contract yet. Start evolving it anyway.
